verdicts.title: ErrorInfo discriminators and JSON-RPC codes hand-mirrored in TS
verdicts.note: Mirroring is real: 45 Go ErrorInfo consts; hostOps.ts:49-66 lists 15 kinds only as a union; CODE_INVALID_REQUEST defined at client.ts:82 and errors.ts:30; jobOutput.ts:125 uses literal -32014 + 'jobOutputPruned'; 22 non-test 'evenerErrorInfo ===/!== "..."' compares; MutationErrorData (errors.ts:441-448) hand-mirrors. But the claim 'nothing links any of these to errors.go' is wrong: errors.test.ts:4 imports appwire/errors.go?raw and binds the exported consts and codes via testing/goConstants.ts (errors.test.ts:98-210, 510-530), so drift of the 9 exported consts and the codes already fails a test. Unguarded part: hostOps.ts kinds, bare literals, jobOutput literal, MutationErrorData, duplicate CODE_INVALID_REQUEST.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Smaller first step: delete the duplicate CODE_INVALID_REQUEST in client.ts (import from errors.ts), name the -32014 literal in jobOutput.ts via one shared const, and extend the existing goConstants binding tests to cover hostOps.ts kinds. Only then consider generating ERROR_INFO catalog (emitter work) so the hand consts and ?raw regex binding tests both go away; keep unknown-discriminator tolerance.

verdicts.title: Enum-typed Go fields emit as string; generator hand-wires 3 enums
verdicts.note: Confirmed: emit.go:36-37 declares only threadItemEventKindType and navigationTargetKindType reflect types; typeExpr (304-313) has per-type cases for 3 enums; writeNameCatalog calls at emit.go:625-639 are hand-listed. types.gen.ts Task.status is 'status: string' (3756), TranscriptDisplayContent level?: string (4595). TaskStatus values exist in appwire/task.go:9-16, tool/definitions.go:910 (inline enum literal), taskListData.ts:9 and :75. 26 'type X string' in appwire. Note agent/internal/tool does not import appwire (agent/task re-aliases appwire.TaskStatus at task_store.go:40), so deriving the tool-schema enum needs agent/task or a small import. Severity medium: drift is guarded at runtime by TS KNOWN_STATUSES and no observed bug.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: As proposed but staged: start with TaskStatus and the transcript-display enums (concrete duplicated sets), proving the registry approach, before migrating all 20 string-typed enums (YAGNI). Keep runtime narrowing of untrusted data.

verdicts.title: ThreadItem.type and thread/turn status values have no constants
verdicts.note: Confirmed ThreadItem.Type is string (appwire/types.go:2068) and literals like "agentMessage"/"commandExecution" are scattered through non-test Go (history_content.go:67,76; output_images.go:165; apptranscript.go; overlay.go). ThreadStatus*/TurnStatus* are untyped consts (types.go:367-380). But item type is Codex-parity and open (item_type_test.go uses mcpToolCall/dynamicToolCall and bare strings), so a closed typed enum would contradict the wire design; the literal counts were not re-verified. Typed constants for the Go-side set Evener itself emits are reasonable, but TS union tightening is risky.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Only add typed TurnStatus/ThreadStatus consts plus a ThreadItemType const block for types Evener itself emits (no closed union on the wire, TS keeps string). Mechanical Go replacement; skip TS union.

verdicts.title: Delegate read model copied 4 times with 5 hand converters; LatestIntent dropped
verdicts.note: Verified: LatestIntent (json latest_intent) exists on agent.DelegateStatusInfo (agent/status.go:158) and events payload (payloads.go:786) but not in server.DelegateStatusInfo (server/server.go:105+), and the three hand converters (cmd/evener/serve.go:2315-2336, server/appwire_runtime.go:2827-2850, cmd/evener-hub/app_threadread.go:1278-1306) copy ~45 fields each without it. The wire type appwire.EvenerDelegateInfo has LatestIntent (types.go:1839) and it is populated only by internal/appprojector/appwire_projection.go:485. Session-activity rows set it separately (agent/session_activity_delegates.go:226), so user-visibility on the detailed-status path is unproven, but the drift already happened. server imports agent (server.go:11), so deleting the mirror is import-legal.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: As proposed. Write failing LatestIntent round-trip test first; confirm with Jesse that LatestIntent flows on the detailed-status path before changing behavior.

verdicts.title: server.DetailedStatus field-for-field copy of agent.DetailedStatus
verdicts.note: agentToServerDetailedStatus starts cmd/evener/serve.go:2232 and runs to ~2345; server/server.go:204 has the MarshalJSON plugin nil-vs-empty workaround; server imports agent. Mirror types not individually re-diffed (Jaccard figures taken from audit) but structure matches. Depends on finding 4.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: As proposed, after finding 4; keep the nil-vs-empty plugins behavior pinned by an existing test before deleting MarshalJSON.

verdicts.title: Many definitions of the same pointer-clone helper
verdicts.note: Verified typed helpers: cloneServerBool/Int64 (server/appwire_runtime.go:2858,2866), cloneServeBool/Int64 (serve.go:2347,2355), cloneHubBool/Int64 (app_threadread.go:1309,1317), cloneBoolPointer/Int64Pointer (appprojector:573,581), cloneBool (agent/status.go:569), cloneInt64 (jobs_activity.go:1293), copyIntPtr/copyBoolPtr (launchconfig/wire.go) plus generic clonePointer in appwire/clone.go:125 (unexported), navigation_projection.go:1887, llm/registry/load.go:622, clonePtr jobstore, ptrClone appsource. The exact total of 19 not recounted. Note appwire's clonePointer is unexported so it must be exported first.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: As proposed; most typed helpers vanish with findings 4 and 5, so do this last.

verdicts.title: Exact-duplicate wire structs in hubapi/hostops justified by a stale comment
verdicts.note: Comment staleness confirmed: hubapi/types.go:30-45 says hubapi 'deliberately does not import appwire' while hubapi/navigation.go:7 imports it and :322 aliases appwire.NavigationMutation. hubAttentionSummaryFromCore (web_api_tree.go:1123) and navigationSubagentTally conversion are hand copies. Corrections: types.gen.ts emits ONE AttentionSummary (137) because same-named identical types are deduped, and internal/appwirets/emit_test.go:370-390 deliberately pins that hubapi/appwire AttentionSummary pair; aliasing removes no generated TS for it (only NavigationSubagentTally vs SubagentTally at 2727/3745 are distinct generated interfaces) and that test must be rewritten. hostops.Boundary does not import appwire today; aliasing needs an import-graph check.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Alias hubapi.AttentionSummary to appwire.AttentionSummary (delete converter, fix comment, adjust the emit_test dedup test to use a different same-name fixture); alias NavigationSubagentTally. Treat hostops.Boundary as optional.

verdicts.title: Transcript-display config implemented twice with separately hardcoded defaults
verdicts.note: transcriptDisplayConfig.ts:23-25 hand unions, :59-60 CONTENT_LEVELS/HOOK_EXIT_DETAILS, :233-245 shipped desktop=tools / mobile=intent with revision 0; Go has TranscriptDisplayShippedDefaults() at transcript_display.go:152. No Go or TS test reads across (the TS tests in the list import only TS). 624-line TS file confirmed. Depends on finding 2.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: As proposed; low-cost first step is a TS test (goConstants-style) binding shipped defaults to the Go function's output via a generated constant.

verdicts.title: Unused aliases, duplicate constants and a twin struct in appwire
verdicts.note: Grep -w over Go/md/mjs/json: KeybindingsGetResponse, KeybindingsChangedNotification, TranscriptDisplayConfigV1, TranscriptDisplayGetResponse, TranscriptDisplayChangedNotification appear only at their definitions (plus docs/audits). TranscriptHookExitNone and TranscriptContentPreset appear only as definitions. TranscriptDisplayChangedParams is field-identical to TranscriptDisplayPatchResponse (transcript_display.go:115-127) but is the registered notification payload (protocol.go:401, protocol_test.go:244, docs/appwire-protocol.md:370,4384) and a generated TS export, so merging renames an export; needs Jesse's nod as noted.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Delete the unused aliases and duplicate consts now; defer the ChangedParams/PatchResponse merge until Jesse approves the export rename.

verdicts.title: Protocol version and size limits retyped across the boundary
verdicts.note: Literals confirmed: ProtocolVersion types.go:35, APPWIRE_PROTOCOL_VERSION client.ts:49, qualify-package.mjs:1148, demoSessions.ts:1210 (a demo error string); MAX_ATTACHMENTS/BYTES vs SendMaxImageItems/Bytes; DOC_FILE_MAX_BYTES 512*1024 vs docFileMaxBytes 512*1024 (doc_serve.go:36); MAX_INTENT_CODE_POINTS 200 vs MaxIntentRunes 200; qualify-package.mjs:103,513 pins the TS side only. Overstated: the protocol version is intentionally a flagday gate (Go flagday_contract_test.go, TS client.test.ts:267 and qualify-package.mjs each pin the literal) so some duplication is deliberate; limits are stable values. No cross-language test does exist for the limit pairs.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Skip protocol version generation (deliberate gates). For the limit pairs, add goConstants-style binding tests (cheaper than emitter work) or emit only the 4 limit constants.

verdicts.title: Go tests regex-scrape TS sources to pin mirrors
verdicts.note: Confirmed: appwire/errors_test.go:274-300 regexes RETRY_SAFE_MUTATION_METHODS out of dispatcher.ts (9-name Set at dispatcher.ts:313-323 vs retrySafeMutationMethods at errors.go:914-933); diagnostic_keyword_parity_test.go regexes RECONNECT_KEYWORDS, its comment says the lists drifted in both directions and that it chose parsing over generating. Step 1 (emit RETRY_SAFE_MUTATION_METHODS via writeNameCatalog) is sound and simple. Step 2 is a product-visible protocol change (older transcripts, recovery affordance) and must be discussed, not planned as cleanup.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Do step 1 only. Leave step 2 as a separate discussion with Jesse.

verdicts.title: LaunchOption declared twice and copied field by field
verdicts.note: app_launch.go:70-105 does copy ~18 fields, but schema.go:55-63 explains the local LaunchOption is deliberately its own struct because Group/Kind/PathKind/DefaultableLayers use typed enums that the builder and resolver validation rely on; embedding appwire.LaunchOption as proposed would lose those types. Effort vocabulary: llm.ReasoningEffortVocabulary exists (llm/types.go ~688) while cmdutil.go:133 hard-codes the case list and schema.go:162 hard-codes the choices; this part is valid.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Only replace the hard-coded effort lists with llm.ReasoningEffortVocabulary. Leave the LaunchOption copy unless typed enums move into appwire (finding 2).

verdicts.title: Protocol method defined and client-stubbed but served by no router
verdicts.note: Confirmed: protocol.go:170 entry says 'served by no evener router', only ScopeUnimplemented user (protocol.go:26; protocol_test.go:30,402; cov_rhub_appwire_test.go:859), Go client wrapper client.go:577, remote_hub_refs.go:620 case, generated TS 4478-4490/5161, no TS consumer. Counterpoints: it is deliberate Codex-parity surface referenced by specs (multi-host-05-remote-hub-source.md:258,1101,1150), has dedicated tests (cov_rhub_appwire_test.go:128, remote_hub_images_test.go:168), and is listed in docs/appwire-protocol.md:199. Removal is a product/protocol decision.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Ask Jesse whether Codex-parity stubs are wanted; if not, delete the method, types, wrapper, ref-rewrite case, tests, ScopeUnimplemented, and update the spec/docs.

verdicts.title: connectFakeClient redeclared in 89 test files
verdicts.note: 89 files in cmd/evener-hub/frontend/src declare 'function connectFakeClient' (none in mobile-native or appwire-client). 73 are the identical no-arg 4-line body, 11 take a state param, 5 other variants. One already exported at panes/session/transcript/messages/testing/heldSteerTestUtils.ts:68. No shared src/testing home exists. Pure test boilerplate with a tiny body, so low severity; the real call-site count of connectionStore.getState().connect( is 750, so the 89 edits scenario is overstated.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Add one shared test util (e.g. src/testUtils/connectFakeClient.ts) for the 73 identical copies via codemod; leave variants. Coordinate with the frontend-tests slice.
